all_live_storylines.headline: NASA Employee Spotlight: Juliana Barajas
all_live_storylines.summary: Juliana Barajas, an administrative assistant at NASA's White Sands Test Facility, has supported NASA's mission for over two decades with a career grounded in service, perseverance, and gratitude. Her work focuses on helping others succeed in the Safety and Mission Assurance Office.

all_live_storylines.headline: FEMA Assistance Deadline Approaches for Kentucky Flood Victims
all_live_storylines.summary: Kentucky homeowners and renters affected by the April severe storms and flooding have until July 25 to apply for federal disaster assistance through FEMA. Applicants can apply online, visit a Disaster Recovery Center, use the FEMA mobile app, or call the FEMA Helpline to receive assistance with their recovery needs.

all_live_storylines.headline: USPS Stamp Encore Voting Open Now
all_live_storylines.summary: The US Postal Service has announced the Stamp Encore Contest, inviting the public to vote for a past stamp pane to be re-printed as part of the 2026 Stamp program, celebrating the organization's 250th anniversary. The contest is a lead-up to the country's 250th anniversary celebration.

all_live_storylines.headline: Institutional Biosafety Committee Meeting
all_live_storylines.summary: The Institutional Biosafety Committee advises on handling biohazardous materials and reviews research projects involving such materials, with a meeting scheduled for October 14, 2025.

all_live_storylines.headline: Vandalism at Gettysburg National Military Park
all_live_storylines.summary: A stone containing a dinosaur fossil on the 'Dinosaur Bridge' at Gettysburg National Military Park was vandalized. The incident occurred on September 26, 2025.

all_live_storylines.headline: Treasury Previews Preliminary Tipped Occupations List
all_live_storylines.summary: The US Treasury Department has previewed a preliminary list of tipped occupations that will qualify for a 'no tax on tips' deduction, with around 70 professions eligible. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been promoting the policy through interviews and visits to businesses.

all_live_storylines.headline: US Food Supply to Remove Artificial Colors
all_live_storylines.summary: The Consumer Brands Association has pledged to remove certified Food, Drug & Cosmetic (FD&C) petroleum-based colors from America's food supply, a move praised by the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).

all_live_storylines.headline: New Citizen Ceremony at Brown v. Board of Education NHP
all_live_storylines.summary: The Brown v. Board of Education National Historical Park hosted a New Citizen Ceremony on September 25, 2025. This event marked a significant moment for new citizens.

all_live_storylines.headline: North Carolina Receives Additional $28 Million for Disaster Recovery
all_live_storylines.summary: FEMA has approved an additional $28 million in reimbursement funds for North Carolina's disaster recovery efforts, bringing the total to $124 million in August alone. The funds will support community cleanup, infrastructure repair, and other recovery work following Tropical Storm Helene and other disasters.

all_live_storylines.headline: US Sanctions Iran Sanctions Circumvention and Political Oppression
all_live_storylines.summary: The US has designated 18 entities and individuals for facilitating Iran's evasion of US sanctions and repression of the Iranian people, including financial and IT firms. The sanctions target those enabling Iran's security services to restrict internet access.

all_live_storylines.headline: Nanticoke River Invasive Fishing Derby
all_live_storylines.summary: The annual Nanticoke River Invasive Fishing Derby encourages the removal of invasive blue catfish and northern snakeheads, promoting fun, science, and environmental conservation. The event is organized by Dr. Noah Bressman, a biological studies assistant professor at SU.

all_live_storylines.summary: The SEC and CFTC staff issued a joint statement regarding the trading of certain spot crypto asset products.

all_live_storylines.headline: 80th Anniversary of Atomic Bombings of Japan
all_live_storylines.summary: The Manhattan Project National Historical Park is hosting commemoration events in Richland, WA to observe the 80th anniversary of the atomic bombings of Japan.

all_live_storylines.headline: US Government Promotes Kindness
all_live_storylines.summary: The US government highlighted the importance of kindness in daily life through a Live Whole Health episode, encouraging practice and citing its positive impact.

all_live_storylines.headline: Hiker Released from Hospital After Grizzly Encounter in Yellowstone
all_live_storylines.summary: A hiker was released from the hospital after a grizzly bear encounter in Yellowstone National Park, where bear spray was noted for its effectiveness in stopping aggressive bear behavior. The park's Bear Management Biologist provided guidance on deploying bear spray.

all_live_storylines.headline: Secretary of State Marco Rubio's 200th Day in Office
all_live_storylines.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio marked his 200th day in office with an interview on EWTN's The World Over.

all_live_storylines.headline: Tijuana River Sewage Crisis Progress
all_live_storylines.summary: The US EPA has announced significant progress in repairs to address the Tijuana River Sewage crisis, aiming for a permanent 100% solution. This milestone is a major step towards resolving the long-standing issue affecting Southern California residents.

all_live_storylines.headline: US Congratulates Honduras on Independence Day
all_live_storylines.summary: The US Department of State congratulated Honduras on its 204th anniversary of independence, expressing hope for continued cooperation on democracy, prosperity, and security. The statement was made on September 15, 2025.

all_live_storylines.headline: EPA Administrator Advocates for Constitution Pipeline
all_live_storylines.summary: EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin emphasized the need for the Constitution pipeline to alleviate high energy costs in New England, citing grid stability concerns. This push comes after meeting with state and local leaders in the region.

all_live_storylines.headline: IRS Hiring Event in Jacksonville, FL
all_live_storylines.summary: The Internal Revenue Service is holding a direct hiring event for seasonal customer service positions to fill over 200 vacancies in Jacksonville, FL. The event will take place on August 19th at the Marriott Jacksonville Downtown.

all_live_storylines.headline: IM Mastery Academy Scheme Settlement
all_live_storylines.summary: Two defendants will pay $10.5 million to settle FTC allegations of using false earnings claims. The settlement resolves allegations related to the IM Mastery Academy scheme.

all_live_storylines.headline: Rural VA Provides High-Quality Healthcare
all_live_storylines.summary: The Iron Mountain VA, despite being the most rural VA in the nation, continues to provide high-quality healthcare to Veterans across over 25,000 square miles. This achievement highlights the VA's commitment to delivering excellent care in remote areas.

all_live_storylines.headline: Unbroken Spirit Empowers Veterans
all_live_storylines.summary: The Unbroken Spirit program offers a life-changing journey for veterans, with 2026 applications now open. This program aims to empower veterans to reclaim their purpose through a year-long initiative.

all_live_storylines.headline: FTC and DOJ Host Listening Session on Lowering Americans’ Drug Prices Through Competition
all_live_storylines.summary: FTC and DOJ Host Listening Session on Lowering Americans’ Drug Prices Through Competition / FTC and DOJ Host Listening Session on Lowering Americans’ Drug Prices Through Competition

all_live_storylines.headline: Justice Department Seeks to Shut Down Texas Tax Return Preparation Business
all_live_storylines.summary: The Justice Department filed a complaint to permanently bar Maxumus Tax LLC and its owner from preparing tax returns for others due to allegedly claiming fabricated credits and expenses. The complaint was filed in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas.

all_live_storylines.headline: Religious Liberty Commission Holds Hearing on Public Education
all_live_storylines.summary: The Religious Liberty Commission held its third hearing to discuss religious liberty issues in public education, including issues related to teachers, coaches, school funding, and educational choice. The hearing featured testimony from school leaders, families, and experts impacted by religious liberty issues in school funding.

all_live_storylines.headline: US Employment Statistics Benchmark
all_live_storylines.summary: The US government released a preliminary benchmark for state and area employment statistics.

all_live_storylines.headline: Honoring Veterans: Army Veteran Edna Cummings
all_live_storylines.summary: The US government honored Army Veteran Edna Cummings for her 25-year service.

all_live_storylines.headline: NASA Glenn Reinforces Role in Aerospace Innovation
all_live_storylines.summary: Ohio Space Week highlighted the state's aerospace legacy and NASA's Glenn Research Center's role in advancing space technology. The week featured the Glenn Space Technology Symposium, where experts discussed emerging space technologies.

all_live_storylines.headline: IRS Hiring Event for Seasonal Customer Service Positions
all_live_storylines.summary: The Internal Revenue Service is holding a direct hiring event to fill over 300 seasonal customer service vacancies in the Atlanta area. The event aims to recruit staff for the Atlanta service center.

all_live_storylines.headline: FORT Science in Action, Part 16
all_live_storylines.summary: FORT researchers study invasive grass biology and management to reduce fine fuels, restore wildlife habitat, and ensure public safety. This research aims to help resource managers make informed decisions.

all_live_storylines.headline: Hiring Veterans: Jobs of the week for Aug. 25, 2025
all_live_storylines.summary: The US government posted job listings for veterans for the week of Aug. 25, 2025. The listings include various locations and job opportunities.

all_live_storylines.headline: Allegheny Portage Railroad National Historic Site Event
all_live_storylines.summary: The U.S. National Park Service hosted an event called 'Evening on the Summit: The Main Line Canal and Underground Railroad' at Allegheny Portage Railroad National Historic Site. The event highlighted the site's historical significance.

all_live_storylines.summary: Michael Fletcher, a passionate advocate for quit-smoking efforts, has passed away. His death was acknowledged by Laura Chanchien Parajón, MD, MPH, Director (Acting) of CDC's National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion.

all_live_storylines.headline: Former Mine Manager Pleads Guilty to Defrauding MSHA
all_live_storylines.summary: A former manager of an Illinois mine pleaded guilty to conspiring to defraud the Mine Safety and Health Administration regarding an underground fire in 2021. The guilty plea was entered by Timothy Brandon Parsons, 38, of Kentucky.
